text:
alex: FYI after the driver/CUDA push to eu-west2 H100 pool (driver 555.82 / CUDA 12.2) we've started seeing a cluster of inference pods fail during JIT compile/link for SM90 and a handful of NCCL collectives hang. About 5-7 H100 hosts impacted, throughput degraded and some pods keep restarting.

maria: which node ids? any kernel oops in dmesg?

alex: nodes: h100-eu-az1-12,17,21,23,29. Kubelet shows ptx link failures and the inference runtime aborting. Snippet: 

```
[2026-03-18T07:12:41Z] nvptx: module load failed: unresolved symbol __shfl_down_idx
[2026-03-18T07:12:41Z] ptx link error (sm_90): illegal PTX opcode / invalid relocation
[2026-03-18T07:12:42Z] inference-svc[pid=8421]: Fatal: kernel compile failed for sm_90, exiting
```

alex: also saw NCCL return NCCL_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION during an allreduce warmup on some pods: 

```
ncclCommInitRank -> returned NCCL_UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION
callstack: ncclAllReduce -> ncclGroupEnd
```

jordan: smells like an SM90 assembler/PTX ABI change from the driver and an nccl mismatch. @sam did we rebuild images against the new host libs?

sam: images were not rebuilt; we rely on driver backward compatibility. Hosts were upgraded with a stricter driver-minimum check in infra. Could be the 555.x PTX assembler differences.

maria: confirm whether this is limited to H100 (sm_90). Are sm_80/sm_86 nodes okay?

alex: yes, looks limited to H100 nodes. sm_80/sm_86 nodes in same region are serving normally. Affected pods show 3-5x latency and periodic restarts.

ops-bot: Incident opened: INC-2026-2001 - "eu-west2 H100 PTX link/NCCL hangs after driver 555.82 rollout" - paging oncall.

jordan: mitigation options: rollback driver per-AZ, cordon/drain troubled nodes, or disable JIT/kern compilation at runtime and traffic-shift to canaries. Disabling JIT will reduce perf but buy time.

sam: quick experiment: setting ML_RUNTIME_DISABLE_JIT=1 on a canary pod to force non-JIT path — if success we can route critical traffic there.

alex: applying that to h100-eu-az1-21 now.

alex: update: pod with JIT disabled started and served traffic, but throughput dropped ~35%. Usable for critical endpoints.

maria: also check host vs container NCCL versions. Mismatched NCCL can yield UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION in collective init.

alex: host NCCL = 3.13.1, runtime image NCCL = 3.12.0. That's likely contributing.

jordan: agreed — two simultaneous problems: PTX/assembler incompatibility with SM90 + NCCL ABI mismatch. Proposed action plan:
1) freeze further driver rollouts to eu-west2 and prepare rollback window if no fix in 60m. ACTION: @infra-release
2) rebuild runtime images against host NCCL (3.13.1) and push canary. ACTION: @sam
3) keep JIT off for critical routes and cordon worst nodes. ACTION: @alex
4) shift high-priority traffic to us-west spare capacity (cost bump). ACTION: @maria

sam: image rebuild ETA ~90-120 minutes. Can promote canary once CI passes.

alex: cordoning now: draining h100-eu-az1-12,17,23,24.

maria: spare capacity in eu-west2 is low (~25-30%). Cross-region shift to us-west will add egress and latency; 24h cost estimate +$5-7k. Need approval if sustained.

jordan: if no recovery in 60 minutes schedule rollback in next maintenance window. Also add SM90 PTX smoke test and NCCL ABI check to our rollout gates.

alex: filed INFRA ticket INFRA-3267 with logs and node list: https://jira.redwood/infr/INFRA-3267

ops-bot: runbook check - "gpu-driver-compatibility" step 3 warns to verify NCCL/libcudart ABI versions pre-rollout. We should add an explicit sm_90 compile test.

sam: will add a canary job in infra-ci to compile a small sm_90 kernel and run a 4-node NCCL allreduce per AZ before driver push.

jordan: long-term tasks: (a) automated SM90 PTX smoke tests in rollout pipeline, (b) align container/host NCCL versions as a release policy, (c) per-AZ driver pinning to limit blast radius.

alex: status T+42m: 4 nodes cordoned, 1 canary with ML_RUNTIME_DISABLE_JIT=1, image rebuild in progress. Traffic limited to critical routes. No global rollback yet.

sam: new image built with NCCL 3.13.1 passed CI smoke. Deploying to canary host now.

alex: canary pod with new image came up (JIT still disabled). NCCL allreduce warmup passed locally. Perf ~80-90% of baseline. Promoting to second canary.

jordan: after 2h stable, toggle JIT on canary to validate full PTX path. If PTX still fails, we'll plan rollback.

ops-bot: INC-2026-2001 updated: status = mitigated, awaiting verification. Assigned = alex, sam, maria, jordan.

alex: final note - block driver rollouts for SM90 pools until infra-ci includes PTX/NCCL checks. Will draft a short postmortem once incident closes.

maria: thanks team. Keep updates here; escalate to emergency-maintenance if we see regressions. :lock:
